notes.title: Second Trailer Released, Plus a Limited-Time Demo Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Second Trailer[/h1]
In the second trailer, we're unveiling key in-game features such as weapon variations, diverse turret placements for attacks, and even a glimpse of the boss alien mothership!

[previewyoutube=ulAmJg1ztyo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Limited-Time Public Demo[/h1]
From August 11th, 2023 (GMT 4:00pm) to August 13th, 2023 (GMT 4:00pm), we are offering a special early access to the demo on the Steam store page. Don't miss out and give it a try!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218190/XALADIA_Rise_of_the_Space_Pirates_X2/]Play Now!![/url]
